previous_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius leads his men onto the trail of the organized bandits identified during the earlier expedition. His stated objective is to destroy the remaining organized bandit force in the region and bring the expedition to an end. The column advances with the discipline, physical conditioning and unusually reliable supply organization developed throughout the campaign.

continuity.campaign_development: Valerius led the expedition back onto the trail of the organized bandit network. After locating its remaining encampment, his force defeated the organized band in a major final action, dismantled its stores and command structure, and began the return march. The campaign's military objective has been substantially fulfilled. The estate, incorporated winter holding, road and lake port remain under administration while the expedition returns.
